conflicts.fact: Lesson 6 cites Atwater factors as taught in Lesson 4, but the lesson map credits Lesson 2 with the energy values (Table 1 carbohydrate), and Lesson 4 with the 9 kcal per g fat factor. This is not a clear conflict, so it is not reported.
conflicts.versions: Lesson 4 teaches 9 kcal per g; Lesson 6 cites Lesson 4 for the Atwater factors. This matches the map.
